title: Systems of Equations and Phase Planes
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Two-Dimensional Autonomous System and Phase Plane
definitions.statement: A two-dimensional system of first-order differential equations describes the velocity vector field (dx/dt, dy/dt) in the xy-phase plane. Trajectories represent parametric solution curves (x(t), y(t)).
conditions: F and G are continuously differentiable
definitions.explanation: Equilibrium points occur where F(x, y) = 0 and G(x, y) = 0 simultaneously.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Phase portraits reveal qualitative dynamics (cycles, saddles, nodes, spirals) of coupled systems.
